query: WITH stopped AS ( UPDATE scan_runs r SET state = 'cancelled', finished_at = now() WHERE r.state IN ('queued','running') AND ($2::scan_mode IS NULL OR r.mode = $2) AND ($1::text IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM providers p WHERE p.id = r.provider_id AND p.slug = $1 )) RETURNING r.id ), abandoned AS ( UPDATE scan_tasks t SET state = 'skipped', finished_at = now() WHERE t.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM stopped) AND t.state NOT IN ('done','failed','skipped') RETURNING t.id ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM stopped) AS "runs!", (SELECT count(*) FROM abandoned) AS "tasks!"
